value.rationale: The theorem is not a restatement of known unpunctured homotopy type: it provides an exact simple-homotopy equivalence for a prescribed induced metric-sample deletion with 36 local elementary collapses per removed vertex, allowing 20 percent of vertices and 60 percent of simplices to be removed while retaining integral topology. The adjacent-erasure Euler counterexample demonstrates that arrangement matters. This exact sparse reconstruction property is useful for topological simplification and for understanding robustness of Rips point-cloud models.
